_schema: GTEC SAST waiver — each entry has (label, file, line, justification, reviewed_by, reviewed_at). Scan classifies matching findings as 'low' severity instead of 'medium/high' because they have been reviewed and documented per directive §4 (no silent suppression — explicit acceptance).

waivers.label: react_dangerous_inner_html
waivers.justification: Static Expo Web root template. All 16 occurrences inject hardcoded SEO JSON-LD, PWA manifest, service-worker registration, analytics init, and font-face CSS — template-literal strings with zero runtime interpolation from user input. This is the React-approved way to inject inline <style>/<script> in SSR/static-export web output.
